title: Using an online form to contact your GP surgery
description: Read about how to use an online form to contact your GP surgery.
text:
# Using an online form to contact your GP surgery

You can contact your GP surgery using a secure and confidential online form on their website.

You can use the form to let your GP surgery know about any symptoms you have, ask a question or follow up about something. This could be either about your own health or on behalf of someone you care for.

Your GP surgery uses the information you give them to make sure you get the right help.

## How to use an online form

You can complete the form on your GP surgery's website.

Find your GP surgery to get their website details.

You may also be able to use the NHS App to access the form.

Just answer the questions and follow the instructions, including any advice about submitting urgent requests online.

If you find it difficult to complete the form or you do not want to use it, you can call or visit the surgery.

## What happens next

After the surgery team have considered your request for an appointment or medical advice, they'll tell you within 1 working day what will happen next.

This could be:

- an appointment that day or the following day

- a phone call that day or the following day

- a text message responding to your query

- advice to go to a pharmacy or another NHS service

## Benefits of using an online form

An online form is a quick and easy way of letting your GP surgery know what's wrong or raising a query or concern. This can help you get the right care when you need it.

It can also be more convenient for some people - for example, if you do not like using the phone, or find it difficult to call the surgery because of work or caring commitments.

## If you need urgent care

For urgent medical help, go to 111 online or call 111 if you cannot get help online.

For emergencies, go to your nearest A&E or call 999 for an ambulance.
